method: Fetch public source pages through inherited proxy with normal transparent User-Agent and TLS verification. Read direct post title/body and indexed page payload createdAt. Preserve only concise excerpts and factual metadata in repository; full fetched HTML temporarily available outside repository.
limitations: A post publication timestamp dates the report, not a verified retail price at that exact second. A currently retrieved post may have later edits.
Slickdeals is a community/staff deal platform with affiliate-supported content; it is not the retailer, and a report is not an independent confirmation of all variants or successful checkout.
No full 90-day or 365-day continuous history, no cross-color/size/revision merging, no backfilling missing dates, and no proven lifetime-low claim.
No usable Canadian dated history acquired in this run; RedFlagDeals returned a challenge page.
Wayback/CDX and archive.org availability endpoint failed with HTTP CONNECT 403; no archive contents were read or inferred.
